name: GitHub Copilot CLI
tagline: GitHub's terminal coding agent, with plan mode, subagents, and MCP.
description: GitHub Copilot CLI is a terminal-based coding agent that reads and edits code, runs commands, and works with GitHub issues and pull requests. It supports plan mode, parallel subagents through /fleet, MCP servers, and custom model providers.

pricing.notes: Included with Copilot Free, Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans; usage draws on the plan's AI Credits.
